text:
Maya: Heads up — triple OT in the college game, but playoffs lineup deadline is 23:59. Who wants to trade bench spots if my goalie turns into a brick wall? :hockey:
Jonah: lol brick wall goalie is my fantasy dream tonight. what do you need?
Maya: Need someone to take Teal (G) off my roster for the night. I can offer my emergency bench spot + one slice of pizza IRL :pizza:
Riley: @Maya I can grab Teal for tonight and drop an extra FW. will you sign the ephemeral jersey swap contract? :laughing:
Sam: vote quick: 1) Trade Teal to Riley 2) Keep Teal and pray 3) Postpone life and watch triple OT (emoji vote)
Maya: quick poll — react with :one: :two: or :three:
Jonah: :one: from me. Also Sam — you owe me a coffee if you pick #3 and actually show up to watch :coffee:
Riley: :one: too. I’ll run the roster change: `/fantasy trade @Maya Teal -> Riley --temp 12h` (will cancel after tonight)
PizzaBot: Order queued: 1x large pepperoni to be delivered if trade completes. Click to confirm: https://pizza.fake/order/xyz
Maya: confirmed the trade on the league site, Riley has Teal. PizzaBot — bless. :pray:
Sam: conspiracy theory: triple OT makes for better office bonding than regular seasons. I support the pizza reward.
Jonah: also, jersey swap reminder: bring your size L Vikings jersey tomorrow for the office shelf swap. No takers? @Riley you good?
Riley: bringing it. Might embroider "OT legend" on the sleeve if we make it past tonight. :stuck_out_tongue_winking_eye:
Maya: thanks y'all — congrats to Riley, may the goalie become an actual brick wall and not a sieve. See you in the channel for the postgame roast/praise party.
